dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm here! Where are you?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈhɪr! ˈwɛr ər juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm at the café, next to the escalator.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ət ðə kæˈfeɪ, ˈnɛkst tə ði ˈɛskəleɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm at the escalator, too. But I can't see you!
dialogue.reading: aɪm ət ði ˈɛskəleɪtər, ˈtuː. bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈsiː juː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's meet at the bank on the first floor.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈmiːt ət ðə ˈbæŋk ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈflɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm coming, too. Wait for me!
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈkʌmɪŋ, ˈtuː. ˈweɪt fər ˈmiː!
